A1.justification: Both PDFs describe SlotSPE and contain readable text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A-I. Content can be reliably matched; v3's longer bibliography shifts appendix pagination without creating material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original survival-prediction experiments across ten TCGA cohorts, with ablations, robustness tests, efficiency measurements, clinical analyses and interpretability results in Section 4 and Appendices D-I.

after.justification: v3 retains the original survival-prediction experiments and supplementary analyses, including benchmark C-indices, missing-genomics evaluations and clinical utility results.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix B retain identical slot attention, selective activation, reconstruction objectives, multimodal interactions and training/inference procedures. The added historical context in Section 2 does not change the method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same ten TCGA cohorts for disease-specific survival, with the same modality coverage and missing-genomics scenarios. The appendix clinical and interpretability cohorts also match.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the benchmark, missing-genomics, encoder, efficiency and clinical comparisons. The three newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Both retain five-fold cross-validation, identical cohort sizes, preprocessing, survival discretization and training budgets. Ablation, efficiency and clinical evaluation settings in the appendices are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The same component and encoder ablations, slot-number/iteration/top-K/temperature analyses, missing-genomics tests, efficiency breakdowns, clinical analyses and interpretability cases remain in Section 4 and Appendices E-I.

E5.justification: Both report standard deviations across five folds, log-rank tests and RMST uncertainty estimated using 1,000 bootstrap replicates (Appendix C; Table 7). No run-count disclosure or statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All matched numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, SlotSPE's overall C-index remains 0.721 with both modalities and 0.704 with missing genomics (Tables 1-2); appendix tables and plotted results also match.

T1.justification: Equations 1-19, hazard and survival definitions, loss formulations and computational-complexity reasoning are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix B. No mathematical assumption, derivation or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about structural event modeling, biological alignment, predictive performance, efficiency, missing-modality robustness and interpretability.

C2.justification: Interpretations of slot specialization, reconstruction-based robustness, computational costs and pathway-morphology associations are unchanged. The qualification that biological hypotheses require further validation is retained; no substantive limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Appendices B, C and G retain the same implementation details, encoders, hyperparameters, patch sampling, hardware and training information. Code and data access instructions are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 adds Li et al. (2020), Li et al. (2021) and Nanbo et al. (2024), with corresponding bibliography entries, to connect slot attention to object-centric representation learning. The existing positioning against fixed-prototype methods remains intact.

P1.justification: One sentence in Section 2's Structural Event Modeling paragraph is expanded and split to introduce the object-centric-learning connection. The remaining scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Spacing and text flow change locally on pages 2-4, and the expanded bibliography spills onto an additional page, shifting appendix pagination. All ten tables and fourteen figures retain their content, styling and captions.

improvement.justification: Section 2 adds a brief historical connection and three references, but v2 already credited slot attention to Locatello et al. (2020). With the method, main and appendix evidence, reproducibility information and conclusions unchanged, this small contextual edit does not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
